R/Pharma is thrilled to bring 25 workshops across Europe/US and Asia Pacific timezones.  Workshops will run between September 28th and October 1st.  Registration is via the R/Pharma [registration page](https://events.zoom.us/ev/Ao58QRuKpY_AuvCDVGqF3tiibvbsLw6MKXn7n_PL2vPdHVQnSAuC~AulApVxluxkRoEef4TZ6ozp1uwmnBHGti8cDERG7p01yOGKH0KXFbLhUNw).
